description: USAGE FLOAT-DECIMAL-16 (ISO/IEC 60559:2020 decimal64, §2023:13.18.60.4 GR17) — a COBOL-2014 introduction that is PROCESSOR-DEPENDENT (Annex A.3 item 19). PENDING: .NET has no IEEE 754 decimal64 type (System.Decimal is a different format) and GR17 pins the format, so WiseOwl COBOL documents it as non-support (rejected loud, COBOL1564); this row would activate if the pinned format is implemented.
